Steps: Login to Citrix application.
Login to Athena software.
Search and open the assigned Claim ID in Athena.
Review claim details, denial reason, notes history, and billing information.
Perform pre-service/claim analysis to identify the next action.
Open the Phone Payer tab in Athena.
Verify payer information and available contact details.
Login to portal.
Cross-reference patient eligibility across clearinghouse portals.
Review any available EOB, Previous, or documents.
A call is placed to the Insurance
Discuss about the claim/appeal/Reprocess status with the insurance representative
Take the information from the representative
Update detailed call notes in Athena.
Validate that all supporting information has been documented accurately.
Save all changes and move to the next claim.
